I can’t reliably compute the final values by hand. You can obtain them by running the assignments in R; the syntax is already valid R apart from the `//` comments. Replace each `// unrelated note ...` line with an R comment (prefix it with `#`), then run the script and print the variables:

```r
print(mget(c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h",
             "i", "j", "k", "l", "m", "n", "o", "p", "TMP")))
```
